definition.description: Retrieves customer details from Microsoft Partner Center API by customer ID. Returns company profile, billing profile, custom domains, and relationship information.

inputFields.helpText: The unique identifier (GUID) of the customer in Partner Center.
Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: The customer's Azure AD tenant ID
Country code from company address (e.g., CH, US)
JSON array of all custom domains associated with the customer
JSON array of tags associated with the customer
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when customer data was successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
